name: lean4-lsp-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Lean 4 theorem proving, zero-latency .ilean navigation, and C FFI cross-language inspection

scripts.test: node --test tests/test_rules_fixtures.mjs tests/test_architecture.mjs && node --test tests/test_harvest.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_lean_lsp_mcp.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_file_worker_manager.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_counterexample_verb.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_project_root.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_diagnostics_ready.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_decl_references.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_abstract_interpreter.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_tranche1_modules.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/test_proof_fidelity_audit.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/test_sota_upgrades.mjs && node tests/test_wasm_integration.mjs

author: r-irbe

tools.name: lean_goal
tools.description: Interactive proof state, before+after goals (col='both'), filtered goal, term goal, and AltProof route/tactic advisor

tools.name: lean_search
tools.description: Unified declaration, semantic, similar_proofs (BM25 + RRF), workspace_symbols, ontology, reservoir, dataset, arXiv, and Kuzu knowledge graph search

tools.name: lean_blueprint
tools.description: Blueprint generation, status audit, zettels, skeletons, and knowledge graph neighborhood

tools.name: lean_metrics
tools.description: Module census, dependency hierarchy, DAG subgraphs, bigraphs, axiom audit, WASM proof_fidelity/SAIR audit, and AltProof analysis

tools.name: lean_ffi
tools.description: C FFI symbol resolution and Lean sysroot inspection

tools.name: lean_exec
tools.description: Ephemeral Lean 4 execution via lean --stdin

tools.name: lean_resync
tools.description: Force full document re-sync with LSP server

tools.name: lean_lookup_symbol
tools.description: Offline symbol lookup in compiled .ilean index

tools.name: lean_decl_references
tools.description: Declaration-level uses/usedBy reference graph from .ilean index

tools.name: lean_module_hierarchy
tools.description: Import DAG traversal for a module with cycle detection

tools.name: lean_axiom_closure
tools.description: Transitive axiom closure check (#print axioms) for a declaration

tools.name: lean_diagnostics
tools.description: Live compiler, linter, Goedel-Prover-V2 <error> spans, and APOLLO static analyzer diagnostics

tools.name: lean_server_status
tools.description: Server attach mode, open files, and RSS memory introspection

tools.name: lean_counterexample_search
tools.description: Galois-pruned Plausible counterexample search in an isolated scratch directory

tools.name: lean_multi_attempt
tools.description: Tri-modal speculative multi-tactic branching without disk mutation (Virtual LSP, lean-repl, Pantograph)

tools.name: lean_repair_proof
tools.description: APOLLO comment/string-safe leaf sorrification, solver cascade, and Rule G-15 sub-lemma extraction

tools.name: lean_minimal_hypotheses
tools.description: Sound unused-hypothesis detector and grouped-binder-aware pruner

tools.name: lean_profile_proof
tools.description: Per-tactic elaboration profiler and heartbeat hotspot analyzer

tools.name: lean_skill_dispatch
tools.description: Self-contained skill and local domain override dispatcher with role-scoped MCP allowlists

tools.name: lean_theorem_preflight
tools.description: Composite Phase-0 theorem preflight: counterexample search, WASM proof_fidelity/SAIR audit, AltProof, and similar_proofs
